deals.summary: Grant test drove the 2026 Shark 6 Premium (Blue) and discussed his high fuel spend (~$150 every four days), which the rep is positioning against home charging. The key open item is the delivery wait time on the Blue, which the rep promised to confirm with the stock team but hasn't yet delivered. Grant has not responded to the last two emails, and the most recent call reached only voicemail — no live contact made.
deals.summary_headline: Awaiting Blue Shark wait-time confirmation
deals.summary_next_step: Get a firm delivery estimate on the Blue from the stock team and call Grant with that concrete answer plus a Saturday drive/appointment offer.

deals.summary: Harfi is committed to buying a Sealion 7 Premium (via a Booran Novated lease through work) but won't proceed until he sells his current car privately for $33,000, having rejected lower offers. He confirmed by SMS he's 'for sure' getting one once the trade sells, and told the rep by phone he'll wait — even up to a year — rather than accept less on the trade. Deal is fully stalled on the trade-in sale, not on price or product interest.
deals.summary_headline: Waiting to sell trade privately at $33k first
deals.summary_next_step: Check back periodically (light touch) on the trade-in sale, and be ready to hold a unit the moment it sells given tight Premium stock.

deals.summary: The Atto 2 Dynamic is for Hari's daughter, who test drove it. On a call, Hari told the rep they're still undecided and his daughter is exploring other options, and expects to have an answer by next week. No specific objections raised yet.
deals.summary_headline: Undecided, daughter comparing options
deals.summary_next_step: Follow up early next week when Hari expected to have a decision, and ask what other vehicles his daughter is weighing to address any comparison concerns.

deals.summary: Ben is negotiating on the Seal Premium and pushing hard on price — the dealer offered 54,238 but he's anchored near 50k. He's justifying his position by citing the 5km demo/near-new status and negative PR around BYD model years, and has signaled he'll walk and shop elsewhere if a deal can't be reached. He's engaging only via SMS.
deals.summary_headline: Price gap: wants near 50k, dealer at 54,238
deals.summary_next_step: Have Elise respond by SMS with a sharper number or added value (accessories, extended warranty) that addresses his MY25 concern, and gauge whether there's a price he'd commit to.

deals.summary: Emma enquired on the used Atto 3 EVO but has replied by email that Mill Park is probably too far for her to get to. She hasn't declined outright or raised any issue with the car itself — the only objection is the travel distance, and she hasn't engaged on the offered viewing dates or requested any spec details.
deals.summary_headline: Distance to dealership is the sticking point
deals.summary_next_step: Reply addressing the distance directly — offer to bring the car to her, arrange delivery, or handle the deal remotely with video/details so location isn't a dealbreaker.

deals.summary: Steve asked via SMS whether the Shark 6 is in stock and said he can only come in Saturday or Monday. Kyle proposed Saturday the 26th but Steve hasn't yet confirmed a time, and the stock check is still outstanding. He's engaging only by short texts.
deals.summary_headline: Wants to visit Saturday, awaiting stock confirmation
deals.summary_next_step: Confirm current Shark 6 stock and text Steve to lock in a specific Saturday time.

deals.summary: Sophie confirmed the Sealion 7 Premium was her and Glenn's favourite over Kia and Hyundai, and was happy with the $56,590 drive-away in blue. She wants grey specifically and asked for it at the same price; when told grey adds $2,000 (taking it to $57,074), she said she'll leave it and shop around. She'd offered to bring her daughters for a Saturday the 8th test drive, but that's now stalled on the paint pricing.
deals.summary_headline: Balking at $2k grey paint upcharge, shopping around
deals.summary_next_step: Call Sophie to see if there's any room on the grey paint or a sweetener to close the $484 gap, and lock in the Saturday test drive before she buys elsewhere.

deals.summary: Daniel ruled out the Seal 6 Touring because it didn't fit his garage, repeating that message across several emails. The rep pivoted to the smaller Atto 2 DM-i plug-in hybrid, and per call notes Daniel expressed interest and wanted to test drive once one arrived. The car is now in stock, but Adrian's latest attempt to let him know was a voicemail — Daniel has not yet responded to the fact a drive is available.
deals.summary_headline: Atto 2 DM-i available; awaiting reply to drive invite
deals.summary_next_step: Reach Daniel directly by phone (or text if he prefers) to book a firm Atto 2 DM-i test drive slot now that the car is on site.

deals.summary: Kenny bought and took delivery of the Sealion 7 Premium, having placed the order via email/phone and paid the $207 B&W plate fee. During the purchase he raised and resolved a price query (deposit not reflected), requested finance/cooling-off contract amendments (subject to novated lease, remove clause 6 default, amend clause 13), and never confirmed whether he settled on millarX or Flare. Post-delivery he has apparently raised questions about servicing/updates and getting his vehicle onto the BYD app.
deals.summary_headline: Delivered — sorting post-delivery app/service issues
deals.summary_next_step: Book the service inspection appointment and follow up on getting his BYD app account manually linked, then confirm his contract amendment requests were actually actioned.

deals.summary: Hasitha is a business buyer (AM Retail Services) whose CBA vehicle finance settled on 1 September at 2:56pm, reference AAU1770668. He emailed the CBA payment confirmation and asked Elise to forward it to accounts so the payment can be located and allocated to the order. The car has cleared port and is on a truck to South Morang; he's now waiting for confirmation the funds appear in the dealer's system.
deals.summary_headline: Finance settled — payment confirmation sent to dealer
deals.summary_next_step: Confirm with accounts that the CBA payment has been received/allocated, then reply to Hasitha with that confirmation and next steps toward handover.

deals.summary: Jason test drove the Shark 6 Performance with his wife and was impressed, and per the rep's notes sat down with Karl to go through the novated leasing figures and seemed happy with them. He asked early on what leasing looks like on a $210k income, and the rep records he isn't committing straightaway because the purchase needs to be arranged through his employer. He engages by SMS but is progressing well in person.
deals.summary_headline: Sold on vehicle, sorting novated lease via employer
deals.summary_next_step: Check in on where the employer novated-lease approval stands and offer to help liaise or supply any paperwork they need.

deals.summary: Dylan came into the showroom to look at the Atto 2 Dynamic and mentioned interest in the demo model, but has not replied to any of the five follow-up emails offering a test drive, nor answered the rep's call (voicemail left, customer not reached). No objections, questions, or intent have been expressed since the visit — the rep is entirely one-sided at this point.
deals.summary_headline: No response since showroom visit — 5 unanswered follow-ups
deals.summary_next_step: Send one short, low-pressure closing message asking Dylan to confirm whether he's still interested or has gone another direction, and stop repeating the demo-availability pitch.

deals.summary: Karamveer has paid in full, completed registration paperwork, and collected his 2026 Shark 6 Performance, which is due back for accessory fitment (suspension upgrade and bulbar). Post-delivery he has two open items: an Uber reimbursement from Wallan to South Morang (receipt and CBA bank details supplied) and a higher-power charger Elise promised at pickup that is now overdue. Earlier he pushed hard on timing, frustrated at waiting weeks for a car already in stock after his finance had already settled.
deals.summary_headline: Delivered — awaiting Uber refund & promised charger
deals.summary_next_step: Process the Uber reimbursement to his supplied CBA account and give a firm status/date on the promised higher-power charger.

deals.summary: Daniel says he has already put a deposit down on the black Sealion 6 demo and spoke with Adrian by phone the same day, so this deal is well advanced past the test-drive stage. He replied (by email) confused and slightly irritated at receiving a cadence email still chasing him for a test drive, asking whether it was automated and requesting confirmation of his order.
deals.summary_headline: Deposit paid — automated emails causing confusion
deals.summary_next_step: Personally call or email Daniel to confirm his deposit and order status, apologise for the automated chaser, and stop the generic test-drive cadence.

deals.summary: Inos came in and saw the Sealion 8 Premium but his wife didn't get to drive it, and the rep is trying to book a weekend test drive so she can. He has a Hilux to trade, but no kilometres or service history have been provided yet, so no trade figure exists. All contact since the visit has been one-way — three emails plus one voicemail with no answer — so nothing has been confirmed by Inos.
deals.summary_headline: Needs weekend test drive for both, wife to drive
deals.summary_next_step: Try a different channel (text or a call at a new time) to lock in a specific Saturday/Sunday slot and get the Hilux km and service details.

deals.summary: This outreach reached the wrong customer: Mohammad says he cancelled his order and received his refund months ago, and states he has no intention of purchasing any vehicle. Ryan acknowledged the CRM ticked a customer with a similar name and confirmed he would close the lead; Mohammad thanked him. The 'sold' status on this record appears to be a data error.
deals.summary_headline: Mistaken contact — deposit refunded, not buying
deals.summary_next_step: Close/suppress this lead and correct the CRM record so the wrong-name mix-up isn't repeated in future cadence steps.

deals.summary: Suzanne has signed the Authority to Register form and sent licence screenshots, confirmed standard plates, and is proceeding with her in-stock Atto 1 after being reassured the 13–18 week timeline was a generic order email (she had threatened to cancel over that wait). She's engaging actively by email and has twice asked to book a test drive — offering Friday before 10am or Saturday morning — which Jorgia has not yet confirmed.
deals.summary_headline: Proceeding; chose std plates, still wants test drive
deals.summary_next_step: Lock in and confirm the test drive time (Friday a.m. or Saturday a.m.) and send the tax invoice once allocation is confirmed.

deals.summary: Adrian sent the demo link and multiple SMS follow-ups on the black Sealion 6 Essential, but Piyu has only engaged once, replying with a single word: 'Price.' No test drive booked, no numbers discussed — the customer is signalling that cost is the concern but hasn't specified budget or objection. All contact so far has been via SMS.
deals.summary_headline: One-word 'Price' reply — cost is the sticking point
deals.summary_next_step: Reply by text with clear pricing (drive-away figure and any offers) and ask what number works for them.

deals.summary: After the standard post-sale onboarding email, Jatinder replied by email asking to cancel: 'Yes please cancel it.' The reply references a 'Pre delivery options' thread, suggesting the cancellation follows an earlier exchange not shown here. No reason for cancelling was given.
deals.summary_headline: Asked to cancel the order
deals.summary_next_step: Call Jatinder to confirm the cancellation request, understand why, and attempt to save the deal before processing any refund.

deals.summary: Lisa brought her family in and test drove the Sealion 8 Premium AWD, and per the rep's note they really liked it — no other 7-seater matched it on cabin space, which is her priority. Her one reservation was wanting a proper opening sunroof rather than the panoramic roof. She has not responded to the rep's repeated emails pushing for a holding deposit, and the latest call reached only voicemail.
deals.summary_headline: Test drove & loved cabin space; sunroof hesitation
deals.summary_next_step: Reach her directly to address the sunroof concern (options/alternatives) before pushing the deposit again.

deals.summary: Shane came in about a Shark 6 Premium for a company fleet (Sample Science Pty Ltd), and the rep has pricing prepared with canopy, mats and tints, plus a comparison against the Workmates. Shane responded by SMS asking Saad to send further info to his work email rather than booking an appointment. No objections raised yet — he's just steering the conversation to email.
deals.summary_headline: Prefers email; wants pricing/comparison info sent
deals.summary_next_step: Email Shane at shane@samplescience.com.au with the itemised Shark 6 pricing and the Workmate comparison as requested.

deals.summary: Medhi visited on Saturday and looked at both the ATTO 3 and the Sealion 5, but hasn't yet decided between them or committed to a test drive. The rep has sent two emails pushing a Saturday 10:00 back-to-back drive and left one voicemail to check on his decision, with no reply from Medhi on any channel yet. He has not responded since the showroom visit, so his current level of interest is unconfirmed.
deals.summary_headline: Deciding between ATTO 3 and Sealion 5
deals.summary_next_step: Try a different channel — send a short text offering the back-to-back test drive to make it easy for him to reply and pick a model.

deals.summary: Suzy has upgraded to the Atto 2 Premium and her order is placed and allocated. She flagged that the invoice showed only a $2,000 discount instead of the $3,000 she was promised (extra $1,000 cashback from her 8/8 purchase); Lewis confirmed the additional cashback and issued a corrected tax invoice with both offers applied, which she accepted. She's now satisfied and simply waiting to be told when to pay and when the car is ready.
deals.summary_headline: Sold — cashback discrepancy resolved, awaiting build
deals.summary_next_step: Continue milestone updates and notify her when the vehicle nears delivery so payment can be arranged.

deals.summary: Joys booked a Saturday appointment (shifted to 11am, with her mum and brother able to attend in her place) and, per the rep's note, came in and indicated she'll be back to place a deposit on the $19,990 Atto 1 Essential. She engages warmly by email and has raised no objections on price or product; a novated lease via millarX was mentioned but not pursued in writing. She is now expected to return to lodge the deposit.
deals.summary_headline: Visited, returning to place deposit
deals.summary_next_step: Follow up to lock in a specific return date/time for the deposit and have paperwork ready.

deals.summary: Meher test drove the Sealion 7 Premium and, per the rep's call notes, is considering selling their petrol car and running an EV alongside their MG hybrid for 'best of both worlds.' Since the drive, the customer has not responded to any of the six dealer emails, and the one call attempt went unanswered — so there's been no direct contact since the visit. No objections or pricing pushback have actually been voiced by the customer.
deals.summary_headline: Test drove Sealion 7; no reply to follow-ups
deals.summary_next_step: Try a different channel — send a short SMS or call at a different time — since the email-only cadence has drawn zero response.

deals.summary: Johnny visited the South Morang showroom and looked at a black BYD Sealion 7 Premium ($61,024.15 drive away), but has not replied to any message or answered any call since. The rep has sent repeated SMS follow-ups and left multiple voicemails around the $2,500 cash back deadline (now passed) and an 8/8 test drive event, with zero engagement from Johnny on any channel.
deals.summary_headline: No response since showroom visit
deals.summary_next_step: Make one final attempt with a genuinely new hook (e.g. the 8/8 test drive event); if still no reply, pause the cadence and mark dormant.

deals.summary: Anil came in and viewed the Atto 3 Evo, and the rep arranged a demo test drive for Saturday. Per the rep's notes, Anil then called back to say he couldn't make it and would reach out when he's free. No new objection or price concern raised — just a scheduling delay.
deals.summary_headline: Postponed test drive, will reach out when free
deals.summary_next_step: Give him a few days, then follow up to offer a couple of flexible test drive slots that fit his schedule.

deals.summary: Simon progressed smoothly from test drive interest to a firm purchase, coming in Thursday to test drive and leave a deposit, and his Shark 6 order is placed and locked with BYD. He was sent the tax invoice with transfer details and replied 'will do' on sending proof of payment. Rep has since sent a post-delivery follow-up requesting a Google review, so the deal appears completed.
deals.summary_headline: Sold & invoiced — awaiting payment/delivery
deals.summary_next_step: Confirm the BYD payment has cleared and proof of payment was received, then verify delivery is complete before chasing the review.

deals.summary: Yesim purchased the 2026 BYD Sealion 5 Premium for her mother Fadime; payment was made, insurance and rego were sorted, and the car was handed over on Saturday 29 August. Throughout the closing steps she engaged almost entirely over SMS (short follow-ups plus thumbs-up replies), handling practical items like the rego number and confirming the model trim. No outstanding concerns remain.
deals.summary_headline: Delivered — Sealion 5 handed over, deal complete
deals.summary_next_step: Check in after a week to confirm all is well and prompt the BYD App survey; watch for any referral opportunity.

deals.summary: Simon has the Atto 3 Premium on an extended/weekend trial and reports it's going well — charged it overnight, sitting at 51% this morning. He texted to confirm meeting Kyle Monday around 1030. He's engaging via SMS in short, positive replies with no objections raised.
deals.summary_headline: Confirmed Monday ~1030 appointment after home trial
deals.summary_next_step: Confirm the Monday 1030 appointment and come prepared with pricing/paperwork to close.

deals.summary: Ray showed initial interest in the Sealion 7 Premium FWD but has not replied to any outreach. Kyle sent intro and offer texts (including a $2,500 cashback ending Friday) and left a voicemail on the deadline day, but Ray has not been reached and has said nothing himself.
deals.summary_headline: No response yet — rep chasing on cashback deadline
deals.summary_next_step: Send a short follow-up text confirming the cashback status and offering to book a test drive, giving Ray an easy channel to reply on.

deals.summary: Pesh replied by text confirming he and (per his wording) at least one other person will come in on Saturday. He hasn't raised any specific concerns yet, though Gary's offer to cover home charging costs, drive-away price with finance, and real-world range are the topics teed up. Engagement is via SMS and brief.
deals.summary_headline: Confirmed coming in Saturday
deals.summary_next_step: Confirm a specific Saturday time and reserve a demo/test drive, then have charging cost, drive-away finance and range figures ready for the visit.

deals.summary: Ashesh test-drove the Sealion 7 Premium and is weighing it on space and running costs for a family of five. He raised novated leasing (rep pointed him to millarX for a quote) and told the rep he's still looking at other options. He's awaiting confirmation on delivery timing/pipeline position, which the rep promised to follow up.
deals.summary_headline: Comparing options, exploring novated lease
deals.summary_next_step: Call Ashesh with the confirmed timing and check whether he's run a millarX novated-lease quote, then surface how the Sealion stacks against the other options he's considering.

deals.summary: Lewis has sent several texts pitching the Shark 6's work-ute credentials (range, 2500kg braked towing) and current offers, but Tanveer has not replied to any of them. The one call logged was left as a message, so there has been no actual conversation. We have no stated intent, concerns or timeline from the customer himself.
deals.summary_headline: No response yet — all outreach one-way
deals.summary_next_step: Make a genuine live phone attempt at a different time of day, and if unreached send one direct question text to prompt any reply.

deals.summary: Megha has purchased the BYD Sealion 8 Dynamic with a $1,000 refundable deposit; the car is on order with an estimated September/October arrival. On a call, Megha told the rep she is happy and aware of the wait times. No paperwork or outstanding concerns have been raised yet.
deals.summary_headline: Order placed, awaiting build & delivery
deals.summary_next_step: Collect the early paperwork (licence, finance/novated lease details, Authority to Register) to avoid handover delays while the build progresses.

deals.summary: Shinto came in and looked at the Sealion 7 Premium and wants to return with his wife for a test drive. Despite repeated dealer outreach across SMS and email, he hasn't committed to a time; on a recent call the rep recorded that Shinto said he'd let them know when he's available. No objections or concerns have been raised — just no confirmed date.
deals.summary_headline: Interested, hasn't locked in test drive with wife
deals.summary_next_step: Give it a few days, then follow up to nail down a specific test-drive time that works for both him and his wife.

deals.summary: Andy came in once to look at the demo Atto 2 Dynamic, but has not responded to any of the dealer's many follow-up emails or returned calls since — the only recent call was a voicemail where he was not reached. The rep's note suggests Andy may be weighing a demo versus a brand-new unit depending on offers, but that's the rep's read, not confirmed by Andy. Open questions on payment method and a possible trade-in remain unanswered.
deals.summary_headline: No reply across months of outreach
deals.summary_next_step: Make one more phone attempt at a different time of day, then send a single plain yes/no close-out email asking whether to keep him on the radar or close the file.

deals.summary: Skye engaged well over email, confirmed a 1pm Friday 14th visit to see the Atto 1 Prem alongside the Dolphin and Atto 2, then cancelled saying they're 'going in a different direction at the moment.' No reason given yet as to whether it's the car or the timing. The rep has asked which it is and whether to check in later; Skye hasn't responded.
deals.summary_headline: Cancelled Friday visit — going a different direction
deals.summary_next_step: Wait for Skye's reply on car-vs-timing; if none in a few days, send one low-pressure email offering to check back down the track.

deals.summary: Fiona has taken delivery of her Mist Grey Shark 6 Premium and emailed back that she's loving it and having fun learning its features. She gave warm, unprompted praise for the team (naming Karl, Luke and Phoebe) and thanked the rep for friendly service. No outstanding issues raised; she's engaging happily over email.
deals.summary_headline: Delivered and happy — asked for review/feedback
deals.summary_next_step: Reply with a warm thank-you and gently prompt her to leave the 5-star Google review and complete the CSI survey while she's enthusiastic.

deals.summary: Alex and partner Amanda have submitted the full finance document set (licence, payslips, bank statement, etc.) and are actively engaged via email. Before signing, Alex asked detailed finance questions (exact repayment schedule, comparison rate/APR, total payable, extra-repayment and early-payout terms, hidden fees) that remain unanswered; the rep promised to get exact figures from the finance provider (Luke) but hasn't delivered them. Alex earlier also asked whether handover could be scheduled around December, which was not clearly addressed.
deals.summary_headline: Finance docs in, awaiting written finance answers
deals.summary_next_step: Get Luke's written finance answers (repayment schedule, comparison rate, total payable, fee/payout terms) and the December timing question answered, then call Alex — he said any time works.

deals.summary: Samuel had a Sealion 7 Premium order (Atlantis Grey) that stalled when life got busy, and has since told the rep by email they're not in a position to purchase now. After multiple campaign follow-ups he explicitly asked the rep to 'pump the brakes,' saying they'll wait for a future promo and will reach out when ready. The rep agreed to stop chasing and asked whether Samuel wants to be flagged on the next offer or prefers to make contact himself — that question is unanswered.
deals.summary_headline: Asked rep to stop following up until ready
deals.summary_next_step: Honour the request and stop active follow-up; leave the door open for Samuel to re-engage on his own terms rather than sending another prompt.

deals.summary: Connor completed his BYD Seal Performance purchase via SG Fleet novated lease; he signed all paperwork (including the Authority to Register electronically) after the finance signoff went through. His main stress was the settlement delay on SG Fleet's end, with a hard deadline of picking up before going overseas or he'd cancel/hold the order 6 weeks. The final dealer email is a congratulations/review-request, indicating the car was delivered and the deal is closed.
deals.summary_headline: Delivered — post-sale follow-up sent
deals.summary_next_step: Confirm delivery went through as expected and check in that Connor is settled with the car before requesting the Google review.

deals.summary: Jodie came in to see the Sealion 5 and had a Friday test drive booked, with Lewis planning to open the boot so she could check a wheelchair fits. By email she cancelled the test drive the day before without giving a reason, and did not ask to rebook. She's currently the one who ended engagement, so intent beyond the wheelchair-fit interest is unclear.
deals.summary_headline: Cancelled test drive, no reason given
deals.summary_next_step: Follow up (email, since that's her channel) to gently check what changed and offer to rebook once it suits, keeping the wheelchair-fit question in mind.

deals.summary: Arthur texted that he and Stefanie were impressed with Elise but have decided to go with the VW ID Buzz, which better suits their current needs (two baby seats plus the dog). They offered to return to Elise for any future BYD interest. This is a clear, polite bow-out after viewing the Sealion 7.
deals.summary_headline: Bought elsewhere — chose VW ID Buzz
deals.summary_next_step: Acknowledge graciously, leave the door open, and move them to a long-term nurture rather than active cadence.

deals.summary: Anne replied 'Stop with thanks' twice to the rep's SMS outreach after an in-person meeting about the Dolphin Premium. No objections or buying signals were raised — she simply requested to stop receiving messages. This is a clear opt-out on the texting channel.
deals.summary_headline: Opted out via SMS — do not contact
deals.summary_next_step: Honour the STOP request — suppress SMS outreach and do not re-contact unless the customer initiates.

deals.summary: Matt has ordered and paid deposit on a 2026 BYD Shark 6 Premium (white), and the car is now on the water. He told the rep by email he expects to have his novated lease sorted by end of that week and will send the details through once done. Earlier he mentioned interest in sports rims and needed a firm price/fitment.
deals.summary_headline: Ordered, car at sea; finalising novated lease
deals.summary_next_step: Wait for Matt's lease details, then confirm receipt and follow up on the sports rims pricing he was quoted.

deals.summary: Kamal came in to see the Sealion 8 Dynamic AWD and was weighing it up with his wife, engaging only via SMS. After a run of follow-ups (and one logged call the rep noted no detail on), he texted that they have decided on another vehicle and thanked Lewis for his time. This reads as a firm, polite decline.
deals.summary_headline: Bought elsewhere — chose another vehicle
deals.summary_next_step: Send a brief courteous acknowledgement, ask which vehicle they chose for feedback, and leave the door open before closing the file.

deals.summary: After an in-person visit and test sit in the Atto 2 Premium, Margaret has three times (all by email) declined to proceed, saying they're holding off on a second car for now. She's polite and appreciative and has promised to come back in when they decide, but has given no timeframe and hasn't engaged with the $2000 offer, spec or colour details. No specific objection beyond timing.
deals.summary_headline: Postponed second-car decision, no timeline
deals.summary_next_step: Stop the active cadence and set a longer-dated check-in (e.g. 2-3 months) as Margaret requested, letting them reach out when ready.

deals.summary: Magdy enquired on the grey 2026 Shark 6 Premium but has not responded to any emails or texts, including a video and repeated offers to book a test drive. The latest call was logged as 'spoke with customer' but the note itself says a message was left, so no actual conversation has happened. All engagement so far is one-directional from the rep.
deals.summary_headline: No real contact yet — rep chasing across all channels
deals.summary_next_step: Make another genuine phone attempt at a different time of day and, if unreached, send one direct SMS asking plainly whether he's still in the market.

deals.summary: After being torn between the Shark 6 and Sealion 7 following test drives of both, Heyam and her husband Sal chose the Sealion 7, which is now built and allocated with a $1,000 refundable deposit down. They're financing via a novated lease, and the rep has followed up with their leasing company for a tax invoice. Note: the deal record still lists the Shark 6, but the confirmation email and delivery timeline are for the Sealion 7.
deals.summary_headline: Sealion 7 ordered — awaiting lease paperwork
deals.summary_next_step: Chase the tax invoice from the leasing company and collect the outstanding paperwork (lease details, Authority to Register, licence copy) to keep the handover on track.

deals.summary: Jason and Karla placed a $1,000 refundable order deposit on a black Sealion 8 Premium AWD, then emailed to cancel citing unforeseen personal family circumstances. They've confirmed their deposit account details are current so the refund can be processed. The cancellation was firm and courteous, with no indication they want to keep the order open.
deals.summary_headline: Cancelled order — family reasons, refund in progress
deals.summary_next_step: Process the $1,000 refund promptly to the original account and confirm completion to Jason and Karla.

deals.summary: Miguel told the rep he wants to place an order for the Sealion 7 but is going through leasing company Eziway (contact Paige) and wants the dealership as his pickup location; he wasn't ready to proceed in June. The deal is waiting on Eziway to send the purchase order through before the order can be locked. Recent call attempts went straight to voicemail, so he hasn't been reached to confirm status.
deals.summary_headline: Ordering via Eziway lease, dealer as pickup point
deals.summary_next_step: Chase Eziway/Paige directly for the PO and text Miguel to confirm it's in motion, since calls aren't connecting.

deals.summary: Zumar test-drove the Sealion 7 in person and the rep followed up by email offering a Saturday side-by-side comparison with the smaller ATTO 3. A voicemail was left about arranging a drive with Zumar's mother, but the customer has not been reached and has not responded to any outreach since the visit.
deals.summary_headline: Post-visit follow-up, no reply yet
deals.summary_next_step: Try Zumar again by phone at a different time to lock in the weekend appointment, ideally including the mother in the drive.

deals.summary: Interest has shifted from the original Atto 2 Premium up to the Atto 3 line — the rep's notes record Thomas is now weighing a new Atto 3 EVO here against a demo Atto 3 Premium priced elsewhere, and said he'll let the rep know what he decides.
